recipe.text: On behalf of all the outcasts, on behalf of all those who have been called monsters... I will show them the real monster!
recipe.label: Deneysel güçlü tını: ikinci Hindi taban sesinin İngilizce okuması

phonemes: ˌɔn bᵻhˈæf ʌv ˈɔːl ðɪ ˈaʊtkæsts, ˌɔn bᵻhˈæf ʌv ˈɔːl ðoʊz hˌuː hɐvbɪn kˈɔːld mˈɔnstɚz... aɪ wɪl ʃˈoʊ ðˌɛm ðə ɹˈiːəl mˈɔnstɚ!
